findings.issue: Footnote suffix *1 caused complete loss of six general-table observations on p.8
findings.resolution: Parse numeric ranges after removing only terminal footnote marker; original dk_text/df_text retained. Apply shared footnote Cavity resonator.

findings.issue: Vertically merged property labels caused 26 detailed observations to be skipped
findings.resolution: Continue property within frequency-labelled rows, reset upon another property label; rows restored on p.20/28/36/38.

findings.issue: Method inference missed spaced/merged footnotes and mixed method vs reference identifier
findings.resolution: Separate method from reference_standard; explicitly use each page footnote and each frequency condition.

findings.issue: Two p.28 product headers are malformed in the original PDF
findings.resolution: Retain source_product_text; map to MCL-HD60 (Type D) and MCL-HD90 (Type D) using manual p.7 and the standard product list.

findings.issue: Detailed table specimen thickness was previously left entirely in page notes
findings.resolution: Single explicit table header thickness copied. Multiple choices preserved without selecting one. p.16 conditional-thickness footnote explicitly prevents claiming one exact specimen thickness.

findings.issue: Summary/detail HD90 Df ranges differ in same official manual
findings.resolution: Retain and flag both published observations; no averaging.

findings.issue: ASCII/full-width parentheses and Type spacing caused duplicate product-name strings
findings.resolution: Normalize punctuation/spacing only; preserve original source product text.

scope_limitations: Numerical tables and explicit footnotes only. Graph curves were not digitized.
Standard construction availability tables contain many resin/thickness combinations without per-construction Dk. Do not join nominal Dk onto every available construction.
Methods and references that appear inconsistent in the original were preserved rather than corrected from outside knowledge.
PDF pages and printed pages differ by one in this manual; both indices are now included.
integration_instruction: Replace only source_id RT0204 rows in root_data.json with root_resonac_corrected.json. Do not concatenate the original RT0204 rows again.
